definitions.baseline: mean daily value over the 28 days before the promo, excluding days covered by any other calendar promo; scaled to promo length
definitions.revenueAttributedToDiscount: INCREMENTAL DTC revenue above baseline (actual - baseline). This is NOT discount dollars given away.
definitions.comparablePriorPromo: nearest earlier promo of the same tier; delta compares per-day sales

postPromo.reason: promo still running -- computed after it closes
